propertyDescriptions.header_schema: centralized schema file. This template fixes the FHR contract URL to the released v0.5.0 version (https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/fhr/v0.5.0); docs/SCHEMA-VERSIONS.md allows other URLs for existing records.
propertyDescriptions.schemaVersion: Version of the FHR schema contract, as "MAJOR.MINOR"; 2.0 from v0.4, 2.1 (extension fields) from v0.5 (docs/SCHEMA-VERSIONS.md).
propertyDescriptions.genomeSynonym: Other common names of the genome.
propertyDescriptions.taxon: Species name and URL of the species information at identifiers.org.
propertyDescriptions.metadataAuthor: Author of the FHR Instance (Person or Org).
propertyDescriptions.assemblyAuthor: Assembler of the Genome (Person or Org).
propertyDescriptions.dateCreated: Date the genome assembly was created.
propertyDescriptions.instrument: Physical tools and instruments used in the creation of the genome assembly.
propertyDescriptions.scholarlyArticle: DOI (without a resolver prefix) of the scholarly article where the genome was published, e.g. 10.5281/zenodo.6762550. A registered DOI without the resolver prefix (for example 10.5281/zenodo.6762550).
propertyDescriptions.identifier: Identifiers of the genome as prefix:accession (CURIE-like).
propertyDescriptions.reuseConditions: license and reuse conditions for the use of the Genome.
propertyDescriptions.masking: masking applied to the genome assembly.
propertyDescriptions.vitalStats: general statistics about the genome assembly; N50, N90, L50 and L90 are contig statistics, the scaffold* fields are scaffold statistics.
propertyDescriptions.checksum: sha2-512/256 checksum value: standard padded base64 of the 32-byte digest (43 characters, then =). Computed by `bioheaders combine` over the exact file bytes; never write or edit a checksum by hand.
propertyDescriptions.assemblySoftware: Assembly software provenance; a legacy name string is also accepted. The contract also accepts a legacy plain-string form (docs/FORMAT.md); this guided form writes the structured object alternative only.
propertyDescriptions.assemblyProtocol: URI of the assembly protocol or workflow documentation.
propertyDescriptions.seqcol_id: Unprefixed GA4GH refget sequence collection top-level digest (sha512t24u); supplied by the user, not calculated by FHR. The GA4GH refget sequence collection digest as supplied by the user; FHR does not calculate it.
